8-3D-1: - LI Light Industrial District
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT8UNDECO_CH3ZODIST_ARTDADLIINDIST_8-3D-1LILIINDI","Title":"8-3D-1: - LI Light Industrial District","Content":"
\n

\n A.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Comply with Section 8-3A-1: ZONING DISTRICTS AND PURPOSE ESTABLISHED.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n B.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Specific Standards for Light Industry:\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 1.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n All mechanical equipment emissions; shipping and/or delivery; or other outdoor activity\n areas shall be located a minimum of three hundred feet (300') from any abutting residential\n districts, or the use is subject to a conditional use permit.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n 2.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n The application shall identify how the proposed use will address the impacts of noise\n and other emissions on adjoining residential districts. More specifically, the following\n adverse effects shall be mitigated through setbacks, buffers, sound attenuation and/or\n hours of operation:\n

\n \t\t\n

\n a.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Noise, odor, or vibrations; or direct or reflected glare detectable by the human senses\n without the aid of instruments.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n b.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Radioactivity and electric or electromagnetic disturbances that unduly interfere with\n the normal operation of equipment, instruments, or appliances on abutting properties.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n c.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Any other emission or radiation that endangers human health, results in damages to\n vegetation or property or which exceeds health and safety standards.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n d.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n In the event that the administrator determines that the applicant cannot adequately\n address such impacts, the use shall be subject to conditional use approval.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n C.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n New development shall incorporate site and architectural design recommendations from\n the Architectural Overlay Design Guidelines for the Central Business District and\n Riverfront Center.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n D.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Any new development shall comply with Section 8-3C-1C of this title regarding site\n improvements.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n E.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Irrigation and drainage ditches shall not be covered, tiled or re-routed as part of\n any new industrial development unless specifically required by the applicable irrigation\n and/or drainage district. Perforated piping may be considered as an option if tiling\n is allowed.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n F.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Certification of Completion: Upon the completion of construction of any industrial\n development, and/or other improvements subject to architectural review approval, a\n written certification of completion shall be prepared by the licensed engineer and\n architect responsible for the approved plan. The certifications shall state that the\n installation of all improvements is in substantial compliance with the city approved\n plans. This certification shall be submitted prior the issuance of a certificate of\n occupancy, signature of a final plat, or release of bond, and is required as a part\n of, and not in lieu of, the inspections performed, and certificates issued by the\n city.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n (Ord. 303, 2-11-2020; amd. Ord. 310, 7-21-2020; Repealed & Replaced by Ord. 370-2022 on 7/19/2022; Amended by Ord. 404-2024 on 6/18/2024)\n
